summary: Iteration 14: Comprehensive testing of Web Audio API integration, visualizations, Power Animal Journey image fix, PayPal integration, and backend router refactoring. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: PracticeTimer.jsx correctly implements Web Audio API with createBrownNoise and createFilteredNoise functions
Audio is procedurally generated (oscillators, filtered noise) instead of external URLs - fixes 403 Forbidden errors
Sound types properly mapped: drums (shamanic pattern), bowls (528Hz), ocean (layered noise), nature/fire/wind (filtered brown noise)
MeditationVisualizer.jsx provides appropriate visualizations: aurora for shamanic, mandala for heart, element-specific for elemental, particles for creative
Eye icon (visuals toggle) correctly controls showVisuals state to hide/show MeditationVisualizer
Volume slider properly adjusts gainNode.gain.value when timer is running
Backend routers refactored into /app/backend/routers/ directory with auth.py, payments.py, dependencies.py
PayPal integration complete with create order, capture order, and webhook endpoints
seed_data_creation: Test user created during Playwright testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web Audio API now generates all sounds procedurally. No external audio URLs used. Power Animal Journey image fixed in MongoDB. PayPal integration added alongside Stripe. Backend routes refactored into modular router files.
